message: Filled in `clamp` using only builtins (`max`/`min`) — no new definitions or renames needed.
diff:
diff --git a/mathutil.py b/mathutil.py
index dd892d7..5135475 100644
--- a/mathutil.py
+++ b/mathutil.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 def clamp(value: float, low: float, high: float) -> float:
-    # raise ValueError if low > high
-    ...
+    if low > high:
+        raise ValueError(f"low ({low}) must not be greater than high ({high})")
+    return max(low, min(value, high))
